head_commit.message:
fix(tui): defer rate limit refresh during startup

Move account rate-limit loading out of the bootstrap path and refresh it in the background after the initial frame is scheduled. Preserve /status refresh behavior by tracking whether a request came from startup or the status command.

Use account/read directly for login status checks so the probe no longer runs the full bootstrap path just to determine auth state.

fix(tui): defer rate limit refresh during startup

Move account rate-limit loading out of the bootstrap path and refresh it in the background after the initial frame is scheduled. Preserve /status refresh behavior by tracking whether a request came from startup or the status command.

Use account/read directly for login status checks so the probe no longer runs the full bootstrap path just to determine auth state.

head_commit.message:
[codex] Fix unified exec test build (#17032)

## Summary
- Remove the stale `?` after `AbsolutePathBuf::join` in the unified exec
integration test helper.

## Root Cause
- `AbsolutePathBuf::join` was made infallible, but
`core/tests/suite/unified_exec.rs` still treated it as a `Result`, which
broke the Windows test build for the `all` integration test target.

## Validation
- `just fmt`
- `cargo test -p codex-core --test all
unified_exec_resolves_relative_workdir`
